meta.title: GoalsPay: save for your goals with your real balance
meta.description: A free app for savings goals and personal finance. Mark what you got paid and what you paid, and put into your goals only money you actually have. No bank connection.
meta.ogTitle: GoalsPay: savings goals with your real balance
meta.ogDescription: Your monthly bills and your goals share one balance. You only save money you actually have.
meta.ogImageTitle: Know what you have. Know what you still need.

meta.jsonLdDescription: Savings goals and personal finance app. It works out your available balance from what you got paid and what you paid, and only lets you put money you have into your goals.

hero.title: Know what you have. Know what you still need.
hero.subtitle: GoalsPay puts your monthly bills and your goals on one balance. You only save money you actually have.

problem.title: Saving without knowing what's left over is guesswork.
problem.lead: A notebook, a spreadsheet and your bank app each show you a piece. Nobody adds them up for you before you set money aside.
problem.quotesLabel: What happens when nothing is connected

quotes.enough: Can I afford to save this month?
quotes.rent: Did I pay the rent… or not?
quotes.monthEnd: I save, and at the end of the month it doesn't add up.

balance.title: A real balance, connected to your goals.
balance.lead: Mark your salary as received and the balance goes up. Pay the rent and it goes down. What you put into a goal comes out of it, and nothing is counted twice.

flow.label: Diagram: you receive {received}, pay {paid} and have {beforeGoals} left. You put {deposit} into a goal and {available} stays available. If you try to save {blocked}, the app won't let you.
flow.blockedMessage: That's more than your balance: you can deposit up to {amount}.

rules.noDouble: A deposit doesn't create a fake expense or duplicate an income. The balance is worked out from what you recorded.
rules.priorSavings: Money you'd already set aside for a goal goes in as prior savings, without touching the balance.

balance.ctaTitle: Try it with your own numbers

modes.title: Finance for your month. Goals for what's next.
modes.lead: You switch modes from the menu. Both read the same balance.

finance.name: Finance
finance.body: Add your regular income and bills once. Each month, mark them as received, paid or skipped.

bullets.oneOff: Extra income and expenses, with their date
bullets.opening: An opening balance to start from what you have today
bullets.analytics: Monthly analytics and a change history

goals.name: Goals
goals.body: Each goal has an amount, a date and a category. You see what you've saved, what's left and how much you need per week.

bullets.movements: Deposits and withdrawals, with a note if you want
bullets.priorSavings: Prior savings for money you'd already set aside
bullets.streak: A streak that counts the days in a row you save

features.title: Made for everyday use.
features.lead: All of this is in the version you can download today.

balance.title: A balance that never doubles up
balance.body: Money in, money out and what's in your goals, as one number you can break down.

streaks.title: Streaks and {count} achievements
streaks.body: Your streak counts the days in a row you save. Achievements unlock on their own.

oneOff.title: Extra transactions
oneOff.body: That extra income or one-time expense, with its date.

widget.title: Android widget
widget.body: Your total savings on your home screen.

opening.title: Opening balance and prior savings
opening.body: Start with the free money you have today. What you'd already set aside for a goal goes straight into it.

currencies.title: 14 currencies
currencies.body: Pick yours when you sign up, from the córdoba and the quetzal to the dollar and the euro.

analytics.title: Analytics and history
analytics.body: How much came in and went out each month, plus a log of what you changed.

reminders.title: Reminders and app lock
reminders.body: A nudge so you don't break your streak, another when a bill is due. The app opens with your fingerprint, face or PIN.

features.achievementSamples: First Step, Perfect Week, Goal Completed…
features.also: Also: light or dark theme, accent color, Spanish and English, screen reader support, and sign-in with Google, Apple (on iPhone), Microsoft or Facebook.

trust.title: Your data, with clear rules.
trust.lead: It's what the Privacy Policy says, in short.

account.title: It lives in your account
account.body: It's stored on our servers. That's why the app needs internet, and why you can switch phones without losing anything.

noBank.title: No bank connection
noBank.body: We don't ask for account or card numbers, and the app doesn't move money.

noSelling.title: We don't sell your data
noSelling.body: We don't use it for advertising or build profiles from it either.

encryption.title: Encrypted in transit
encryption.body: The app talks to the server over HTTPS, and passwords are stored as a hash.

lock.title: Your fingerprint stays on your phone
lock.body: Fingerprint or face unlock is handled by your phone. We never receive that data.

deletion.title: Delete your account from the app
deletion.body: It's deleted right away. Technical backups are overwritten within 30 days at most.

cost.question: How much does it cost?
cost.answer: It's free today. Later there may be paid premium features. If that happens, we'll tell you the price and what's included first, payments would go through the App Store or Google Play, and we'll never charge you without your explicit consent.

bank.question: Do I have to connect my bank?
bank.answer: No. GoalsPay doesn't connect to banks, cards or payment methods, and it doesn't move money. Income, bills and deposits are records you type in yourself.

currencies.question: Which currencies can I use?
currencies.answer: Fourteen: US dollar (USD), euro (EUR), quetzal (GTQ), Mexican peso (MXN), córdoba (NIO), Costa Rican colón (CRC), balboa (PAB), lempira (HNL), Brazilian real (BRL), bolívar (VEF), Dominican peso (DOP), Argentine peso (ARS), guaraní (PYG) and Chilean peso (CLP).

newPhone.question: What happens if I change phones?
newPhone.answer: Install the app on the new one and sign in with your account. Your goals and movements are in the account, so they show up the way you left them.

internet.question: Does it work offline?
internet.answer: No. The app needs a connection to read and save your data, because it lives in your account and not on the phone.

deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: In the app, go to Settings → Delete account. Your data is deleted right away and backups are overwritten within 30 days at most. If you can't sign in, email <mail>{email}</mail> from your account's email address. <link>See all the details</link>.

availability.question: Where do I get it?
availability.answer: For now, as an Android APK from this page. We're getting ready to publish on Google Play and the App Store. The iPhone version will arrive with the App Store.

whoCanUse.question: Who can use it?
whoCanUse.answer: People aged 18 and over. It's a tool to organize your money: it isn't a bank and it doesn't give financial advice.

finalCta.title: Start with your first goal.
finalCta.subtitle: Download the app, create your account and mark your first income. From there you'll know how much you can set aside.
